boundary.description: From the point where Hyndburn Brook crosses M65 Motorway, near junction 7. W along the M65 Motorway to junction 6 Whitebirk roundabout N along Whitebirk Drive A6119 to and by the Leeds and Liverpool Canal N to Side Beat Bridge N by the Hyndburn – Blackburn with Darwen civil boundary to and by Whalley Old Road, Then E by Wilpshire Road, Lee Lane, Norden Brook to the point opposite Barons Way, and by a beeline to and E along Hyndburn Brook to its confluence with River Calder.
